summary: Iteration 48 — Backend + Frontend testing of the three NEW 33-day Consecration Challenges (St. Joseph, Marian, Sacred Heart) and their matching daily renewal prayers in the Prayer hub. All 20 backend pytest cases PASS: GET /api/challenges/admin/all returns the 3 new slugs each with total_days=33, status=draft, non-empty opening/closing prayers, and end_dates of 03-19, 05-31, and Easter+68 (June 4, 2027). GET /api/challenges/admin/{slug}/days returns exactly 33 day docs for each consecration with required fields (title, theme, patron_saint, reflection) and 2–4 prayer_items. Frontend Prayer hub (/prayer) lists the 3 new renewal cards at the bottom (testIDs prayer-card-st_joseph_renewal / marian_renewal / sacred_heart_renewal). Opening each renewal shows the HIGHLIGHTED note callout (testID prayer-note) on the first step only, followed by Sign of the Cross + Act of Renewal steps. Language switching works: Italian translation is fast (<5s) and correct; Spanish translation needs ~10–15s (live LLM call) and then renders correctly — both the note callout and the prayer text translate. Admin Challenges screen (/admin/challenges) lists all 3 new consecrations in DRAFT (0/33 published) with Generate-missing/Regen/Publish controls. NOTE: The visible dates on admin are 2027 (Feb 15→Mar 19, Apr 29→May 31, May 3→Jun 4) because today (2026-06-20) is past the 2026 windows — _next_window_for_today correctly advances to the next future occurrence. No mocked APIs. Deprecated package check: code uses Ionicons from @expo/vector-icons (OK); no expo-av/expo-barcode-scanner/expo-background-fetch usage seen in the touched files.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/challenges.py is 1248 lines — exceeds the 700-line guideline. Consider splitting helpers (seed, AI gen, models) into separate modules for maintainability. Not blocking.

Renewal `steps` end with the Act of Renewal but do NOT include a closing Sign of the Cross. Minor — acceptable for a 3-min renewal, but main agent may want to mirror the other chaplets that bookend with two Signs of the Cross.

The Spanish translation of the note can take 10–15s on first open (live LLM call), which feels slow without a spinner specifically over the note callout. The translator does cache after the first call. Consider an inline shimmer on the note while translating.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all 7 review-request checks verified: hub listing, note callout EN/IT/ES, prayer body translation, admin Challenges listing)

seed_data_creation: None. Used pre-existing admin token test_home_layout_24h and pre-seeded challenges + 99 day-docs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend secure-storage stores values as JSON.stringify'd strings — to inject the session token via localStorage on web preview use: localStorage.setItem('sanctus_session_token', JSON.stringify('test_home_layout_24h')). The i18n lang key 'sanctus_lang' is stored as a raw string (no JSON wrap). LLM-based translator (used in prayer/[kind].tsx via useTranslator) needs 10–20s on uncached language switches — always sleep ≥15s before asserting translated note text.
